fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Badgers From Mars still displays the original teal and red cardboard tuck boxes on its own archived game page https://www.regicidegame.com/the-game_copy/. The teal box art matches the armored figure and palette on its original illustrated English rules https://www.regicidegame.com/site_files/33132/upload_files/RegicideRulesA4.pdf. The publisher distinguishes the later plastic second edition and revised card art at https://badgersfrommars.com/en-eu/products/regicide-2nd-edition. This crop uses the teal original box only. Reduced to 254 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently committed regicide takes the first turn.
clarifications: Players cooperate to defeat the Castle deck.
With one player, that player begins by default.
